brief: A marketplace moderates product reviews. Each review can independently be spam (promotion, links, referral codes, selling something), harassment (attacks on a person), or off_topic (not about the product). Action: remove when the review is spam or harassment, flag for a human when it is only off-topic, keep otherwise. Negative but genuine reviews are kept.
